svg.title: Visitor admission and session sequence
svg.desc: Authentication, application session admission, and paid-action authorization are three distinct decisions. The short application session is independent of identity-token lifetime. Unknown accounting, expired sessions and exhausted allowances must deny paid work.

text.tspan: Application contract - not implemented | REFERENCE DESIGN - NOT DEPLOYED
